Delay mux initialization until actual output configuration is known
Preserve trim, codec delay and decoder preroll exactly once
Drive split playback from consumed media samples, not elapsed context alone
Make audio preload, batching and render deadlines separate budgets
Prefer qualified audio wrapping over unnecessary audio decoding
Choose seek-versus-skip using validated container boundaries
Construct checked metadata projections with bounded offset fixpoints
Use consumer-owned source-priority and cancellation leases
Recover reconnect overlap with explicit identity and confidence levels
Keep clock epochs and transition metadata tied to their source
Reuse subtitle content independently of placement updates
Expose repairs and resynchronization instead of silently discarding data
Build an oracle matrix with independent structural and behavioral references
Limit live work by dependency-group deadlines, not VOD policy
Publish narrow contracts for prepared-media reuse and virtual presentations
